user.title: Connect Norish
user.description: Connect your self-hosted Norish instance. Create an API key in Norish under Settings → User → API keys.

data_description.url: Address of your Norish instance, e.g. https://norish.example.com
data_description.api_key: API key from Settings → User → API keys

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Norish
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

data_description.api_key: API key from Settings → User → API keys

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Norish. Check the URL and that the instance is reachable.
error.unexpected_response: Norish returned an unexpected response. Is this really a Norish instance?

abort.already_configured: This Norish instance is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the grocery list is fetched, in seconds (minimum 15).
data_description.show_store: Appends the store assigned in Norish to the description, e.g. "200 g · Rewe".

invalid_auth.message: The Norish API key was rejected. Please re-authenticate.

stale_version.message: "{name}" was changed in Norish at the same time. Please try again.

item_not_found.message: The item {uid} no longer exists in Norish.

rename_not_supported.message: Norish does not support renaming items. Only checking and unchecking is possible.

description_not_supported.message: Norish does not support changing the description. Amount, unit and store can only be changed in Norish.

empty_name.message: The item name must not be empty.
